apps.name: Quill
apps.subtitle: Your story, one beat at a time
apps.localizedDescription:
Your story starts here. Quill is a writing workspace for iPhone and iPad, with a companion browser app. Write everything yourself, call on AI when you need a hand, and keep your story organized from the first idea to the final page.

A BOOKSHELF OF YOUR OWN
Start at an illustrated writing desk, open the animated bookshelf, and give each book its own cover. Open a book to reach its Codex, manuscript, and saved drafts. Custom artwork, clear action icons, light and dark themes, and reduced-motion options make the workspace your own.

WRITE ONE BEAT AT A TIME
The manuscript editor is your starting point. Generate opens a chapter beat planner so you can write or review the map before generating each beat individually. Show beats to edit separate blocks by hand or ask AI for a revision. Prompt the next beat directly below your writing, or select a word, sentence, or paragraph to Revise, Rephrase, or find contextual Synonyms. Review suggestions before applying them; saved revisions and partial drafts keep your work recoverable.

YOUR STORY'S CODEX
Keep the story summary, plot beats, writing style, and character profiles together for the AI to reference. Build characters yourself or generate editable profiles covering appearance, personality, backstory, motivation, relationships, and arcs. Upload portraits or generate them with Apple Image Playground on supported devices. Ask for the next plot beat when you need inspiration.

READ AND REVIEW YOUR MANUSCRIPT
Update from manuscript proposes missing Codex context, developments, and character details for you to review. The Plot holes section looks for possible contradictions and missing links, with supporting evidence and possible fixes. Track findings as open, resolved, or dismissed. AI findings are suggestions for the author to assess.

FROM DEDICATION TO EPILOGUE
Add and reorder title and copyright pages, dedication, epigraph, contents, foreword, preface, introduction, prologue, chapters, interludes, epilogue, afterword, acknowledgments, appendix, glossary, bibliography, an author page, and custom sections. Use formatted writing, focus mode, spell check, search, word counts, and goals. Export Word, EPUB, HTML, plain text, or print/PDF.

MANAGE DRAFTS AND MODELS
Each book has its own Drafts area to review, export, or delete unwanted beat maps, writing attempts, and Codex suggestions. Manage Models lets you choose, download, update, or remove models to free storage. Downloads show their percentage beside the name and a progress bar.

CHOOSE YOUR AI
Use Apple Intelligence on supported devices, or download Qwen, Llama, and Gemma models. Compatible WebGPU browsers also offer Qwen, Llama, and SmolLM2. Connect your own model through an OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic Messages API. Local models have no AI usage fees; initial downloads, compatible hardware, storage, and memory are required. Optional API providers may charge and receive the story context used for generation. Apple controls Intelligence and Image Playground availability.

SAVE AND TAKE YOUR STORY WITH YOU
Automatic local saving, revision history, recoverable deleted items, full backups, and optional shared-folder sync help keep your writing available. Your writing stays on your device by default. iCloud Drive folder sync works while the app is open; desktop Chrome and Edge can share that folder, while other browsers use backup import/export.

Requires iOS 16 or later; AI features have additional device requirements. Install through AltStore Classic.

Browser app: https://kharrisongit.github.io/Quill/

NEW EDITING TOOLS
Automatic offline English spell checking underlines unrecognized words in red; tap for corrections or review later with manual Spell Check. Select writing to Revise, Rephrase a passage, or choose a Synonym for one word. Find & Replace visits highlighted manuscript matches with previous/next arrows, replaces one at a time by default, and offers an optional Replace all checkbox. Adjust writer text size and enjoy larger beat editing areas. Insert export-ready page breaks at the cursor. Generate the next beat with an optional description. Customize the default beat prompt and avoided phrases in Settings. Each generated beat is planned and reviewed for repeated ideas, clichés, stalled action and continuity, with up to two rewrites when flagged. Reviews take extra time and API requests; model judgment can still miss problems. The latest manuscript ending stays in context. Open-book page controls turn to the Codex or resume your last edited section.

versions.localizedDescription:
Synonym suggestions are more reliable across writing models.

- Accepts JSON, numbered or bulleted lists, one suggestion per line, and lists with short definitions instead of discarding usable answers.
- Supports short alternatives such as “came across,” alongside single-word synonyms, and preserves the selected word’s capitalization.
- Uses a focused context-based prompt and automatically retries once with simpler instructions when an answer has no usable suggestions.
- Fixes nearby context for selections deep in long beats. Rephrase also accepts wrapped JSON and numbered alternatives.
- Stop cancels recovery. Nothing changes until you tap a suggestion, and only the selected text is replaced; earlier writing stays in history.

Suggestions still depend on your selected model. Names and some words may have no suitable alternative; Quill distinguishes an unreadable response from an empty list instead of telling you to change models.

Beat generation now checks its work for repetition.

- Each generation first plans one concrete new development, then drafts and reviews that same beat against the preceding manuscript.
- Review looks for repeated ideas even when reworded, renewed resolve or contemplation without action, continuity errors, and stock emotional or symbolic explanations.
- Exact checks catch repeated eight-word phrases and an editable list of avoided phrases, including “weight of” and “a reminder.” Edit the list in Settings → Beat generation alongside your default prompt.
- Flagged drafts receive up to two rewrites. Rewrites remove redundant material rather than swapping in synonyms, and never generate an additional beat.
- Beats can end below their target word count to avoid padding. Location continuity is checked silently, without requiring a setting recap.
- Stop or a failed rewrite keeps the available prose. Remaining issues are shown with the saved suggestion; nothing replaces manuscript text until you apply it.

The review passes take extra time and additional requests with API models. Model judgment can still miss repetition or other writing problems. Custom default prompts remain intact.

More control over every word.

- Every story beat now receives editable default instructions for clear prose, fewer clichés and repetitions, concrete story progress, and consistent locations and actions. Customize or restore the prompt in Settings. The latest manuscript ending stays verbatim in the generation context, and beat plans identify already-written events.
- The floating selection button is now Revise. Select a sentence or passage for Rephrase, or a single word for Synonyms. Review alternatives from your chosen writing model in a pop-up and tap one to replace just that selection.
- Automatic offline English spell checking underlines unrecognized words in red as you type. Tap an underlined word for suggested corrections or remember a character name. Turn live checking off in writer preferences and use manual Spell Check whenever you are ready.
- Find & Replace stays above the manuscript. Previous/next arrows visit and highlight individual matches, including across book sections. Replace one at a time by default, or enable the Replace all checkbox. Formatting, beat boundaries, and earlier revisions are preserved.
- Adjust writing text from 14 to 32 px using Text size in the editor tools. Your preference survives closing and reopening Quill.
- Generated beat suggestions now have a much larger, resizable text area. Highlighted beat text boxes are roomier too.

Includes focused replacement, live spelling, cross-section navigation, persistence, and model suggestion checks. Simulator checks remain skipped by default.

- Automatic offline English spell checking underlines unrecognized words in red as you type. Tap an underlined word for suggested corrections or remember a character name. Turn live checking off in writer preferences and use manual Spell Check whenever you are ready.
- Find & Replace stays above the manuscript. Previous/next arrows visit and highlight individual matches, including across book sections. Replace one at a time by default, or enable the Replace all checkbox. Formatting, beat boundaries, and earlier revisions are preserved.
- Adjust writing text from 14 to 32 px using Text size in the editor tools. Your preference survives closing and reopening Quill.
- Generated beat suggestions now have a much larger, resizable text area. Highlighted beat text boxes are roomier too.

Includes focused replacement, live spelling, cross-section navigation, persistence, and model suggestion checks. Simulator checks remain skipped by default.

A book you can step into, with practical editing tools.

- New light and dark palettes: ivory, teal, and copper by day; midnight blue, sea glass, and gold by night.
- CODEX and WRITE! now sit on the open book page. Pages turn toward the front for Codex, or toward your last edited section for writing, then fade into the screen. Writing restores its saved position.
- Generate the next beat with a single press. The description is optional; the AI can continue from the manuscript, beat plan, and Codex.
- Edit with AI appears beside highlighted manuscript text, including deep inside a beat, and disappears when the selection is cleared.
- Built-in offline English Spell Check offers corrections and remembers character names or invented words on your device.
- Find & Replace searches the current section or the whole book, with whole-word and case options. Formatting, beat boundaries, and earlier revisions are preserved.
- Insert page breaks at the cursor. Breaks survive saving, backups, and Word, EPUB, HTML/print, and text exports.
- The writing desk fits the screen without page scrolling or white safe-area gaps. The footer slogan is removed.
- A simpler sidebar keeps book sections and bottom options with standard icons. Codex moves to the editor tools; redundant Outline and Manuscript navigation is removed.

Verified with automated data and publisher tests, browser workflows, and an iPhone build. Simulator checks remain skipped by default.

Readable writing in dark mode.

- Fix button labels, page headings, book titles, and other text retaining light-mode colors on dark backgrounds.
- Improve contrast for writing placeholders, chapter synopses, manuscript quotations, and generation/save error messages.
- Refresh the browser cache so the corrected colors reach the web app too.
- Update the AltStore description and README to cover Quill’s bookshelf, Codex, characters, beat-by-beat writing, book sections, drafts, model choices, and manuscript review tools.

Release checks include automated data and publisher tests, browser workflows, and the iPhone build. Simulator checks are now optional and skipped by default for faster device testing.

Your manuscript, one beat at a time.

- Generate opens a chapter beat planner. Review or write the beat map, then generate each beat separately on the manuscript page. Existing prose stays in place.
- Show beats highlights editable blocks with their own directions and AI revision buttons. Hide beats returns to continuous writing. Add a blank beat or prompt the next beat directly below the manuscript.
- Select a word, sentence or paragraph and choose Edit selection with AI. Review the proposed replacement before applying it; surrounding writing and earlier versions are preserved.
- Add front matter, story sections and back matter: title page, copyright, dedication, epigraph, contents, foreword, preface, introduction, prologue, chapters, interludes, epilogue, afterword, acknowledgments, appendix, glossary, bibliography, author page and custom sections. Reorder them in the manuscript; all sections export together.
- Update from manuscript reads the current writing and proposes missing Codex context, developments and character details. Review and edit additions before saving. Existing character fields and notes are preserved.
- Plot holes in the Codex checks the manuscript for possible contradictions and missing causal links. Review supporting passages and possible fixes, then track findings as open, resolved or dismissed. Findings are suggestions, not established story facts.
- Every button has an action icon. Settings now uses a recognizable gear, models a chip, and the bookshelf a shelf symbol.
- Beat maps, AI writing attempts and revisions are saved in each book’s Drafts. Generation can be stopped while keeping its output. Concurrent manuscript changes block stale AI replacements.

Includes phone-sized interaction tests for beat planning, individual generation, selected-text editing, cancellation, failed-save recovery, section exports and reviewed Codex updates. AI quality and availability depend on your chosen model and device.

A new home for your stories.

- Start at an illustrated writing desk with BOOKSHELF and SETTINGS. Open the bookshelf, tap a book, and watch its cover open into the book’s CODEX and WRITE! menu.
- Every new book appears on the shelf. Add or change a custom cover in Book details & cover; covers are resized for storage and saved with backups and sync.
- Find DRAFTS inside each book. Review or export saved outlines, generated chapter attempts and Codex suggestions; search, filter and select multiple drafts for permanent deletion.
- Draft cleanup removes the selected text and all its saved checkpoints. Text already added to the manuscript or Codex is kept. Tiny deletion records prevent older backups and updated synced devices from restoring discarded drafts. Existing exported backups retain their copies.
- Model downloads show their percentage beside the model’s name and a progress bar underneath, including downloads started from the chapter writer or character tools.
- Custom illustrated buttons and headers, paper and ink colors, book-opening transitions, animated highlights, a physical bookshelf, and refreshed light and dark themes. The manuscript remains easy to read.
- Reduce animations in Settings, or use your device’s Reduce Motion preference. Settings stays universal: writing models, API connections, appearance and backup/sync. Draft management belongs to each book.

Includes checks for draft deletion, retained manuscripts and other books, cover persistence, model progress and phone-sized navigation. Native model inference and Image Playground still depend on device support.

Your story’s Codex, and more choice over the models that write with you.

- Open Codex inside a book for its story summary, plot beats, writing style and characters. Existing plot beats and character notes appear there automatically.
- Build characters by hand or generate an editable suggestion using your selected writing model. Keep track of appearance, personality, backstory, motivation, relationships and character arcs.
- Generate a character portrait with Apple Image Playground on supported devices, or upload your own image. Apple’s availability and usage limits apply. Portraits are saved with character revisions and backups.
- Generate the next plot beat, edit it, and explicitly add it to the plot. Chapter outlines, prose, characters and beat suggestions all reference the Codex.
- Manage Models shows downloads, installed space, update/download controls, and deletion of model files, older copies and partial downloads. Books and drafts are preserved.
- Add Llama 3.2 1B/3B and Gemma 3 1B choices on iPhone/iPad alongside Apple Intelligence and Qwen. Compatible browsers also offer Llama and SmolLM2; Gemma is native-only in this release. Device memory requirements still apply.
- Connect custom model APIs using OpenAI-compatible chat completions or Anthropic Messages. Enter a base URL, model ID and optional key; save, test, edit, select or remove each connection. iPhone keys use Keychain; browser keys last for the current tab session. Other API formats require an adapter.

Local writing has no usage fees. Optional APIs send relevant story context to your selected server and may incur provider charges. Apple Intelligence downloads are managed in iOS Settings. The chapter writer still requires review and approval of an editable outline before writing prose.

Shape your chapter before Quill writes it.

- A full-screen chapter writer replaces the pop-up panel.
- Generate an outline first, edit its events and ending, then choose Approve outline & write chapter. You can also write your own outline.
- Outline edits autosave and remain available after reopening Quill. Every prose request receives the approved outline unchanged.
- Fix the misleading story-context error on short prompts with empty plot beats by removing the hidden outline summarization loop. Long story-note errors now identify the relevant section.
- Keep the writer open during outline creation, chapter writing and model downloads. Stop & keep draft preserves partial output.
- Saved outlines and generated drafts remain separate from the manuscript, with previous versions preserved.

Includes Apple Intelligence and Qwen switching, full-book plot beats, and Qwen model update checks. This release keeps the existing model choices.

Free chapter writing and full-book plot beats.

- Write one chapter at a time from a prompt and approximate word target.
- Keep the full plot and writing preferences in the new Plot beats page.
- Switch between Apple Intelligence and Qwen inside the iPhone/iPad app.
- Use Qwen in supported WebGPU browsers on computers and Android.
- Choose balanced Qwen 1.7B or the lighter 0.6B model. First use downloads model files; there are no AI usage charges.
- Check for Qwen model updates and download them without replacing a working copy until the new model loads.
- Review generated drafts before using them. Partial drafts are kept when stopped, and older manuscript versions remain recoverable.
- Tap outside sidebars and dialogs to dismiss them. The chapter writer stays open while generating, with an explicit Stop & keep draft button.

Apple Intelligence needs a supported device with iOS 26+ and Apple Intelligence enabled. Qwen needs sufficient memory (and WebGPU in browsers). Chapter length is approximate. Real-device generation speed and prose quality vary by model and hardware.

Quill 1.0.3 — simpler chapter controls.

- Delete chapter is available only in the ⓘ chapter-details menu.
- Removed chapter-delete buttons from the chapter list and desktop sidebar.
- Deletion still asks for confirmation and remains recoverable in Recently deleted.

Quill — your story starts here.

- A dedicated novel-writing app for iPhone and iPad, with a matching GitHub Pages browser edition.
- Books, chapter outlines and reordering, formatted prose, scene breaks, focus mode, native/browser spell check, and dark appearance.
- Character, place, idea, and research notes; chapter synopses and writing status; manuscript and session word goals.
- Local autosave, immutable saved revisions, parallel-draft review, and recoverable trash.
- Word (.docx), EPUB, formatted HTML, plain text, print/PDF, and complete JSON backups.
- Optional shared-folder sync. Choose the same iCloud Drive folder in the iPhone app and desktop Chrome/Edge. Other browsers use backup import/export. Files handles cloud delivery; sync runs while the app is open.

iOS 16+. Install Quill.ipa through AltStore Classic. Physical-device installation and iCloud delivery still need verification on your devices.

Web app: https://kharrisongit.github.io/Quill/
Source: https://github.com/kharrisongit/Quill

Quill 1.0.2 — easier chapter deletion.

- The ⓘ button now opens a chapter-details dialog with a clearly labeled Delete chapter button.
- Each chapter in the chapter list has a trash button. Deletion asks for confirmation and remains recoverable in Recently deleted.
- Chapter status and synopsis can be edited in the dialog, with explicit Save details and Cancel controls.
